newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Former Ecuadoran goverment manipulated data - Concha.
newsitem.headline: Former Ecuadoran goverment manipulated data - Concha.

text.p: The former Ecuadoran government manipulated data to show a sound economy, but it actually is in critical condition, the new Finance Minister Pablo Concha said.

"The former government concealed and strategically manipulated the numbers to tell the country it was leaving behind a sound economy," he charged Sunday. "But it has left a sick country, in emergency."
Concha said President Abdala Bucaram, who took office earlier this month, will deliver in the coming days a speech to the nation to inform about the "true" economic situation.
He said cash deficit is running at about four percent of a Gross Domestic Product estimated at $17.9 billion.
